title: Gartech Vercel Bot
shortDescription: Gartech AI Assistant & CRM
description: **Gartech AI Chatbot** is a modular‑monolith platform that delivers AI‑powered conversational experiences across web and WhatsApp channels. Built with **Next.js App Router** for the frontend and a **Node.js/Express** backend, it leverages **MongoDB Atlas** for persistent storage, **Redis** for rate‑limiting, **Gemini AI** via the Google Generative AI SDK for LLM responses, and **Qdrant** for vector‑search‑based Retrieval‑Augmented Generation. The system orchestrates chat ingestion, context retrieval, prompt augmentation, and streaming responses while silently extracting qualified lead information into a CRM‑ready `Lead` collection.
longDescription:
The core architecture follows a **domain‑driven modular monolith** pattern. The `/app` directory hosts the Next.js UI and API routes, using route groups like `(chat)` and `(auth)` to isolate concerns without affecting URLs. The primary chat endpoint `POST /api/v1/chat` (also exposed as `/api/chat` for streaming) receives a user message, invokes `queryQdrant` to fetch relevant knowledge base vectors, augments the system prompt, and calls the Gemini model, streaming the response back to the client. *Behind the scenes*, the `extractAndSaveLeadInfo` routine parses the conversation for lead attributes (name, phone, capacity, land size) and persists them via Mongoose schemas.

Data ingestion is handled by a PDF parsing pipeline that chunks documents, stores raw text in `FAQ`/`KnowledgeItem` collections, and pushes embeddings to Qdrant. The vector store is queried in real‑time to provide RAG capabilities, ensuring answers are grounded in the uploaded knowledge base. *Security* is scaffolded with NextAuth.js (MongoDB adapter) for session management, JWT‑based strategies, and planned middleware for authentication, rate‑limiting (Redis‑backed), and centralized error handling.

The backend resides under `/backend/src` with clear layers: `config` for env validation, `routes` for API gateways, `controllers` for request handling, and `services` for business logic (AI, conversation state, WhatsApp webhook processing, CRM integration). Persistence is abstracted via `lib/db/connection.ts` and `lib/db/queries.ts`, providing typed access to `Chat`, `Message`, `Lead`, and knowledge collections. *Telemetry* and analytics hooks are earmarked for future integration, feeding metrics into an admin dashboard at `/admin`.

Deployment targets **Docker** containers on **Vercel** (frontend) and **Google Cloud Run** (backend), enabling horizontal scaling. The codebase includes TypeScript typings throughout, ensuring type safety across API contracts and database models. Continuous development is supported by utility scripts such as `scripts/make-admin.js` for role management.
myContributions: Implemented the central chat orchestration in `app/api/chat/route.ts`, integrating Qdrant vector search and Gemini streaming responses.
Developed `extractAndSaveLeadInfo` to automatically parse qualified lead data from conversations and persist it to MongoDB.
Configured NextAuth.js with a MongoDB adapter for persistent session handling and role‑based access control.
Created Mongoose schemas for `Chat`, `Message`, `Lead`, `FAQ`, and `KnowledgeItem` to enforce data integrity.
Built the Qdrant client wrapper (`lib/qdrant.ts`) to manage embedding generation and similarity queries.
Added utility scripts (`scripts/make-admin.js`) for admin role promotion and user management.
Implemented UI components for chat input, slash commands, and theme toggling in React/Next.js.
Set up Dockerfiles for both frontend and backend services, enabling containerized deployments.
Documented the full architectural map in `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/Gartech Codebase Deep Dive.md`.
Outlined middleware scaffolding for authentication, rate limiting, and error handling in the backend audit documentation.

features: Web chat UI with streaming AI responses
WhatsApp webhook integration (backend ready, UI pending)
RAG‑enabled knowledge base using Qdrant and Gemini embeddings
Automatic lead extraction and storage in MongoDB
Role‑based admin dashboard placeholders for leads and analytics
Theme switching and slash‑command shortcuts in the chat UI
CRUD interfaces for FAQs and knowledge items (backend ready)
Rate‑limit ready architecture using Redis (planned middleware)
Telemetry hooks for future analytics and reporting
challenges: Balancing real‑time streaming performance with the latency of vector search and LLM calls
Ensuring lead extraction accuracy without false positives, requiring careful prompt design
Managing connection pools for MongoDB during hot reloads in a serverless environment
Designing a modular monolith that can later be split into microservices without breaking contracts
Implementing robust security (auth, rate limiting) after the initial MVP phase
learnings: Integrating Gemini via the Google Generative AI SDK requires direct REST calls for model listing and custom request handling.
Qdrant vector search provides low‑latency similarity retrieval but demands careful embedding dimension management.
Next.js App Router API routes can serve as effective streaming endpoints when combined with server‑sent events.
Mongoose connection pooling must be guarded against multiple instantiations in serverless functions to avoid connection exhaustion.
Domain‑driven folder structures simplify future service extraction and improve code discoverability.
architectureOverview: Frontend built with React, Next.js, TailwindCSS. AI/ML capabilities powered by Gemini AI. Persistence managed by MongoDB, Redis. Deployed using Docker, Vercel.

remotionVideoScript.voiceoverScript: Welcome to the comprehensive 5-minute technical engineering deep dive into gartech-vercel-bot. Section 1 System Topology: Engineered with TypeScript, JavaScript, combining a decoupled backend powered by Node.js Express API Router and client interface built with React, Next.js, TailwindCSS. Section 2 Static Code Analysis: AST code scanners inspect package manifests and component dependencies. Section 3 API Network Layer: Exposing 4 REST and WebSocket routes with parameter validation schemas. Section 4 Source Code Hierarchy: Codebase organized into isolated modules across App, Api, Models, Components. Section 5 Intelligence & Persistence: AI inference accelerated by Gemini AI with persistence managed by MongoDB, Redis. Section 6 Performance Metrics: Optimized with 1080p rendering and -16 LUFS loudness normalization. Section 7 Deployment & Outro: Explore the complete repository on GitHub at Sameer-Bagul slash gartech-vercel-bot.
